# Form Orchestrator Specification

## Controlled Components (NetlineUI Bridge)

You MUST use the `Controller` for all NetlineUI components to ensure proper state binding.

```typescript
import { Controller } from 'react-hook-form';
import { NetlineTextField } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';

<Controller
  name="passengerName"
  control={control}
  render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
    <NetlineTextField
      {...field}
      label="Passenger Name"
      error={!!fieldState.error}
      helperText={fieldState.error?.message}
      status={fieldState.error ? 'error' : 'default'}
    />
  )}
/>
```

## Multi-step Wizard Pattern

Combine step-specific Zod schemas for the final submission.

```typescript
// Step 1 Schema
const Step1Schema = z.object({ origin: z.string().min(3) });

// Step 2 Schema
const Step2Schema = z.object({ paxCount: z.number().min(1) });

// Final combined validation
const FinalSchema = Step1Schema.merge(Step2Schema);
```

## Integration with Orval Zod Schemas

Reuse Zod schemas generated by Orval from your OpenAPI spec:

```typescript
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { BookingCreateSchema } from './api/generated/zod/schemas';
import { useCreateBooking } from './api/generated/bookings';
import type { BookingCreate } from './api/generated/models';

function BookingForm() {
  const { control, handleSubmit, formState: { errors } } = useForm<BookingCreate>({
    resolver: zodResolver(BookingCreateSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      passengerName: '',
      flightNumber: '',
      date: new Date(),
    },
  });

  const { mutate: createBooking } = useCreateBooking();

  const onSubmit = (data: BookingCreate) => {
    createBooking({ data });
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>
      <Controller
        name="passengerName"
        control={control}
        render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
          <TextField
            {...field}
            label="Passenger Name"
            error={!!fieldState.error}
            helperText={fieldState.error?.message}
          />
        )}
      />
      <Button type="submit">Create Booking</Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

## Field Arrays Pattern

Handle dynamic lists of fields (passengers, items, etc.):

```typescript
import { useForm, useFieldArray, Controller } from 'react-hook-form';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import { 
  Button, 
  IconButton, 
  Box, 
  TextField, 
  Typography 
} from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
import { Add, Delete } from '@mui/icons-material';
import { z } from 'zod';

const PassengerSchema = z.object({
  firstName: z.string().min(1, 'Required'),
  lastName: z.string().min(1, 'Required'),
  age: z.number().min(0).max(120),
});

const BookingSchema = z.object({
  passengers: z.array(PassengerSchema).min(1, 'At least one passenger required'),
});

type BookingFormData = z.infer<typeof BookingSchema>;

function MultiPassengerForm() {
  const { control, handleSubmit } = useForm<BookingFormData>({
    resolver: zodResolver(BookingSchema),
    defaultValues: {
      passengers: [{ firstName: '', lastName: '', age: 0 }],
    },
  });

  const { fields, append, remove } = useFieldArray({
    control,
    name: 'passengers',
  });

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(console.log)}>
      {fields.map((field, index) => (
        <Box key={field.id} sx={{ mb: 2, p: 2, border: 1, borderRadius: 1 }}>
          <Typography variant="h6">Passenger {index + 1}</Typography>
          
          <Controller
            name={`passengers.${index}.firstName`}
            control={control}
            render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
              <TextField
                {...field}
                label="First Name"
                error={!!fieldState.error}
                helperText={fieldState.error?.message}
                fullWidth
                sx={{ mb: 2 }}
              />
            )}
          />

          <Controller
            name={`passengers.${index}.lastName`}
            control={control}
            render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
              <TextField
                {...field}
                label="Last Name"
                error={!!fieldState.error}
                helperText={fieldState.error?.message}
                fullWidth
                sx={{ mb: 2 }}
              />
            )}
          />

          <Controller
            name={`passengers.${index}.age`}
            control={control}
            render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
              <TextField
                {...field}
                type="number"
                label="Age"
                error={!!fieldState.error}
                helperText={fieldState.error?.message}
                fullWidth
              />
            )}
          />

          {fields.length > 1 && (
            <IconButton 
              onClick={() => remove(index)}
              color="error"
              aria-label="Remove passenger"
            >
              <Delete />
            </IconButton>
          )}
        </Box>
      ))}

      <Button
        startIcon={<Add />}
        onClick={() => append({ firstName: '', lastName: '', age: 0 })}
        variant="outlined"
      >
        Add Passenger
      </Button>

      <Button type="submit" variant="contained" sx={{ ml: 2 }}>
        Submit Booking
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

## Conditional Validation

Validate fields based on other field values:

```typescript
import { z } from 'zod';

const BookingSchema = z.object({
  tripType: z.enum(['one-way', 'round-trip']),
  departureDate: z.date(),
  returnDate: z.date().optional(),
}).refine(
  (data) => {
    // Require return date for round-trip
    if (data.tripType === 'round-trip' && !data.returnDate) {
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  },
  {
    message: 'Return date is required for round-trip',
    path: ['returnDate'],
  }
).refine(
  (data) => {
    // Ensure return date is after departure date
    if (data.returnDate && data.departureDate > data.returnDate) {
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  },
  {
    message: 'Return date must be after departure date',
    path: ['returnDate'],
  }
);
```

## File Upload Handling

```typescript
import { useForm, Controller } from 'react-hook-form';
import { Button, Box, Typography } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
import { CloudUpload } from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useState } from 'react';

interface DocumentFormData {
  passport: FileList;
  visa?: FileList;
}

// Mock upload function
async function uploadDocuments(formData: FormData): Promise<void> {
  console.log('Uploading:', formData);
}

function DocumentUploadForm() {
  const { control, handleSubmit } = useForm<DocumentFormData>();
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const onSubmit = async (data: DocumentFormData) => {
    const formData = new FormData();
    if (data.passport?.[0]) {
      formData.append('passport', data.passport[0]);
    }
    if (data.visa?.[0]) {
      formData.append('visa', data.visa[0]);
    }
    // Upload with API
    await uploadDocuments(formData);
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>
      <Controller
        name="passport"
        control={control}
        rules={{ required: 'Passport image is required' }}
        render={({ field: { onChange, value, ...field }, fieldState }) => (
          <Box sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
            <Button
              variant="outlined"
              component="label"
              startIcon={<CloudUpload />}
            >
              Upload Passport
              <input
                {...field}
                type="file"
                accept="image/*,.pdf"
                hidden
                onChange={(e) => {
                  onChange(e.target.files);
                  if (e.target.files?.[0]) {
                    const reader = new FileReader();
                    reader.onloadend = () => {
                      setPreview(reader.result as string);
                    };
                    reader.readAsDataURL(e.target.files[0]);
                  }
                }}
              />
            </Button>
            {fieldState.error && (
              <Typography color="error" variant="caption">
                {fieldState.error.message}
              </Typography>
            )}
            {preview && (
              <Box sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                <img src={preview} alt="Preview" style={{ maxWidth: 200 }} />
              </Box>
            )}
          </Box>
        )}
      />

      <Button type="submit" variant="contained">
        Upload Documents
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

## Form State Persistence

Save form state to localStorage:

```typescript
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { useEffect } from 'react';

interface BookingFormData {
  name: string;
  email: string;
}

const defaultValues: BookingFormData = {
  name: '',
  email: '',
};

const STORAGE_KEY = 'booking-form-draft';

// Mock create booking function
async function createBooking(data: BookingFormData): Promise<void> {
  console.log('Creating booking:', data);
}

function PersistentBookingForm() {
  const { control, handleSubmit, watch, reset } = useForm<BookingFormData>({
    defaultValues: () => {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : defaultValues;
    },
  });

  // Watch all fields and save to localStorage
  useEffect(() => {
    const subscription = watch((value) => {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(value));
    });
    return () => subscription.unsubscribe();
  }, [watch]);

  const onSubmit = async (data: BookingFormData) => {
    await createBooking(data);
    // Clear saved draft after successful submission
    localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    reset();
  };

  return <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>{/* ... */}</form>;
}
```

## Guidelines

1. **Always use Controller** - For Netline UI components (NetlineTextField, etc.)
2. **Reuse Orval Zod schemas** - Don't duplicate validation logic
3. **Use zodResolver** - Integrate Zod with React Hook Form
4. **Handle errors gracefully** - Show field-level errors with helperText
5. **Use useFieldArray** - For dynamic lists (passengers, items)
6. **Validate conditionally** - Use Zod's refine() for complex rules
7. **Persist form state** - Save drafts to localStorage for better UX
8. **Type everything** - Use TypeScript interfaces from Orval-generated types
